segments.text: Then Job answered and said,

verses.text: Even to-day is my complaint rebellious: My stroke is heavier than my groaning.

segments.text: Even to-day is my complaint rebellious:

verses.text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

segments.text: Oh that I knew where I might find him!

verses.text: I would set my cause in order before him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

segments.text: I would set my cause in order before him,

verses.text: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.

segments.text: I would know the words which he would answer me,
And understand what he would say unto me.

verses.text: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? Nay; but he would give heed unto me.

segments.text: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power?
Nay; but he would give heed unto me.

verses.text: There the upright might reason with him; So should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

segments.text: There the upright might reason with him;

verses.text: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; And backward, but I cannot perceive him;

And backward, but I cannot perceive him;

verses.text: On the left hand, when he doth work, but I cannot behold him; He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him.

verses.text: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

segments.text: But he knoweth the way that I take;

verses.text: My foot hath held fast to his steps; His way have I kept, and turned not aside.

segments.text: My foot hath held fast to his steps;

verses.text: I have not gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

verses.text: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

verses.text: For he performeth that which is appointed for me: And many such things are with him.

verses.text: Therefore am I terrified at his presence; When I consider, I am afraid of him.

verses.text: For God hath made my heart faint, And the Almighty hath terrified me;

segments.text: For God hath made my heart faint,

verses.text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
